frozen_coverage.interpretation: Before/after groups differ in time, market and selection; these totals do not estimate the body guard's causal effect. OFF refers to the optional previous-trade structure gate, not the separate active same-bar opportunity claim.

proven_previous_trade_association.basis: Same scoped symbol; previous episode's actual close and recorded close-known time both precede current decision; association bounded by loaded history.
proven_previous_trade_association.interpretation: Associations are neither independent opportunities nor counterfactual strategy returns. No proven previous trade does not mean first-ever trade. No claim that a structural reset did or did not occur between trades.

descriptive_metrics_reconstructed_from_f.basis: Frozen current directional price and closed 15m structure; sign-adjusted for BUY/SELL. This is retrospective arithmetic on entry-time evidence, not proof that these exact metrics were recorded or used at the time.
descriptive_metrics_reconstructed_from_f.precision: Displayed medians rounded to six decimal places; no bin or cutoff selected.
counter_evidence: Winners have larger median EMA60 extension and larger prior directional 4h return than losers. The JCT losing pair does not justify a generic extension or prior-return veto.
Losers have larger median directional taker share; stronger observed one-sided taker flow alone does not establish more profitable continuation.
Winning and losing trades both exhibit partial body retracement. Cohort maximum retracement is about 0.643 and occurs among winners, not only losers.
Volume medians differ descriptively, but traded-candidate selection, symbol clustering, market timing and multiple comparisons prevent claiming an independent predictive effect.

interpretation: The second entry consumes a different closed 15m bar. It is not the same-bar duplicate that the opportunity claim is designed to reject.
The current body guard rejects full body invalidation, not a 26.38 percent partial retracement. Both candidates correctly passed its present contract.
First entry was farther from its breakout anchor in ATR units than the losing second entry. Blindly reducing the existing breakout chase-distance limit could reject the winner first.
Second entry has stronger observed taker buying, which is counter-evidence to a simple exhaustion explanation.
Both JEV results were real and timely; their uncalibrated hypothesis scores are not win probabilities or proof of model benefit.

code_contracts_verified.finding: Opportunity identity includes symbol, side, profile and last closed 15m bar; it does not prove reset since a previous closed trade.
reentry.mode OFF returns without querying or applying previous-trade structural checks.
Only fully erased confirming body is actionable; partial retracement and prior returns are explicitly observation-only.

Public model features include measured ATR, EMA20 gap, relative volume, taker flow, returns and eligible funding/spread; not breakout anchor, body-retention observations, EMA60 extension or previous-trade structural-reset state.

missing_evidence: Complete causal between-trade path and structural-reset labels were not reconstructed in this bounded review.
The current unprivileged read-only role could not read v2_reentry_observations; no role expansion or broad scan was performed.
Frozen entry facts and realized outcomes do not supply a counterfactual path after altered entries, exits, risk sizing or model thresholds.
There is no matched or randomized JEV comparison for this pair or this cohort.
Testnet measurements and fills do not prove equivalent LIVE liquidity, slippage or market impact.

next_hypotheses.name: SAME_DIRECTION_NEW_BAR_VERSUS_NEW_STRUCTURE
next_hypotheses.question: After a closed trade, does renewed consolidation or pullback/resume confirmation distinguish a genuinely new opportunity from another extension of the same move?
next_hypotheses.evaluation: Freeze explicit causal reset/confirmation definitions before evaluating a later, unused time window. Retain all eligible candidates, unavailable evidence and baseline outcomes; evaluate under one fixed rule version.
next_hypotheses.falsifier: No reliable incremental separation after accounting for direction, symbols, opportunity clustering, selection and market timing, or unacceptable rejection of profitable sustained trends.
